title: Salmon with Apricot Miso Glaze
description: Apricot and white miso glaze salmon while it bakes in its own shallow sauce.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {apricot}, {miso}, {ginger} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Start with the room-temperature 4-qt glass container, no crisper plate. Let sauce cool to lukewarm before adding to the glass. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Portion the fish
steps.text: Arrange {salmon} in two even pieces about ¾ inch thick.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Fit the 4-qt adapter and PowerPod and select Bake. Cook for 10–15 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. Finish at 145°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Flaky fish is best freshly cooked; thaw slowly and keep covered. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For gentler Option B, omit added citrus, vinegar or chile where used. Pass additional heat at the table. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 326 kcal, 27.0 g protein, 14.9 g total carbohydrate, 17.2 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 314 mg sodium.

steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {apricot}, {miso}, {ginger} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 365°F on Bake. Choose a shallow baking dish. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Portion the fish
steps.text: Arrange {salmon} in two even pieces about ¾ inch thick.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Place the baking dish on the middle rack. Cook for 12–18 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. Finish at 145°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving.
